Streamline your daily productivity and everyday learning with the Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 15IRU8! Engineered with a responsive 13th Gen Intel Core i3 processor, high-speed LPDDR5 memory, and a slim, portable chassis, this laptop is designed to deliver reliable performance for work, study, and media consumption on the go.
